children: Bengaluru: The Karnataka HC has quashed a 482.70 crore penalty slapped by the state government over limestone mining operations in Kalaburagi district on cement major ACC Ltd, in a major relief to the Adani Group company.

A division bench comprising Chief Justice Vibhu Bakhru and Justice KS Hemaleka also directed the Department of Mines and Geology to restore the cement maker's full access to the integrated lease management system (ILMS) portal. In its 89-page judgment, delivered on September 8, the bench ordered the state to execute a supplementary lease deed extending ACC's mining rights without insisting on a "no-dues certificate".- Our Bureau

title: HC Quashes 483 crore K'taka Penalty on ACC
